corrections.why: The county tower report gives the Lima Mountain tower at 47.9866, -90.4036. The record's latitude is about 9 km south of that point.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county report and the kjackson.us page give about 1976; North Shore Visitor gives 1978. The story uses 1976 and notes the 1978 figure.
The county report gives 1934 or 1935 and North Shore Visitor gives 1935. The kjackson.us page says the tower was used from 1935 and the CCC cabin was finished in May 1936.

sources.title: Cook County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers (report)

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree: removal 1976 (county report, kjackson.us) versus 1978 (North Shore Visitor); the story keeps 1976 and notes 1978. The kjackson.us '1935 to 1956' use claim comes from a book it cites (Nina's North Shore guide, p. 147), which was not read. The record's latitude 47.90343 appears wrong; the county report and the A-Z list give 47.9866, so a correction is proposed. Do not merge with 'Lima', a separate tower near Remer in Cass County listed in the A-Z list. No staffing or fire history was found. A HathiTrust catalog record of a ranger photo at the tower site appeared in search only and was not read. The record's existing Weebly photo was not re-checked for licence.
